title: Add lifecycle error and privacy knowledge
summary: Five new knowledge articles with code samples were added covering try-function semantics, upgrade phase data writes, install-versus-upgrade dispatch logic, ErrorInfo privacy exposure, and FeatureTelemetry logging, plus related review skills were updated.
key_points: Added five focused rules with good and bad AL examples for TryFunction calls, upgrade phases, install code dispatch, ErrorInfo classification, and FeatureTelemetry.LogError payloads
Integrated new rules into error-handling, upgrade, and privacy review skills with typed ErrorInfo retrieval and upgrade-helper analysis
Corrected conflicting guidance in existing articles about install behavior, validation triggers, and ErrorType usage
All changes validated through frontmatter checks, knowledge-index tests, JSON parsing, and reference resolution
